question: Mr. Tappei, thank you for all your hard work. Could you tell us about your state of mind while writing Arc 9, and anything that was particularly difficult?
answer:
Writing the secrets I've been sitting on for 14 years is so much fun!!!!!

I've been holding back the secrets about Aldebaran for 14 years, after all. I finally got to release all the things I'd been holding back, so it felt really good!!

I updated the web version of the relevant episode just before the autograph session at the MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival, and when I saw everyone who had read it sitting there going “............”, I thought, “Thank you!” It was like a scene straight out of hell at that autograph session (laughs).

Arc 9 was different from the usual writing style because Subaru was absent, and Al also got to demonstrate just how insane it would be if you were to use the Return by Death loop ability to its fullest without any restrictions. I had an absolute blast writing it.

I'm always wracking my brain over what kinds of hardships to put Subaru through, but this time I was able to depict developments that Subaru himself can't use, as well as a scenario where he exhaustively uses his looping ability while everything around him becomes his enemy. So I'm extremely satisfied with how it turned out.

As for what I struggled with... Arc 9 was fun to write the whole way through, so I didn't really struggle with anything in particular!
